name: Imran Khan
real_life_parallel: PM 2018-2022; ousted April 2022; arrested 2023; political collapse symbol

biography.background: Prime Minister of Pakistan during Balakot (2019) and Article 370 fallout. Ousted via no-confidence April 2022. Arrested May 2023 on corruption charges. Represents Pakistani civilian leadership subordination to military establishment.
biography.pm_tenure: 2018-2022 — 'Naya Pakistan' rhetoric; military ultimately controlled security policy
biography.ousting: April 2022 — no-confidence vote; allegations of army orchestration
biography.film_relevance: Part 3: PM during Balakot crisis. Part 4: Ouster/arrest as adversary instability.
